statement: Hemalurgy can transfer Allomantic or Feruchemical powers; its outcome depends on how and where the spike is used. This does not define a complete binding-point map.
implementation: Canonical SpikeLedger records typed extraction and donor provenance; intentional extraction and source-specific implantation/removal are implemented. Exact point coordinates remain labelled interpretations.

statement: Represent each grant independently and retain its origin. Removing one source preserves unrelated grants. This is a data-model interpretation, not a complete account of spiritweb damage.
implementation: PowerGrant and canonical anatomical leases preserve unrelated grants. Removing an implant revokes only its source; extracting an externally granted power drains the parent spike.

statement: Distinct Allomantic spike sources add to the strongest non-spike base; duplicate records from one source count once. Feruchemy uses the strongest access grant. Exact stacking and technical/effect caps are gameplay interpretations.
implementation: Spiritweb.strength preserves raw grants and source identities. Physical handlers retain effect caps; stronger Feruchemy does not bypass charge costs.

statement: Canonical world ledgers own individual invested assets. Item references never mint charge. Relevant ability, contact and Identity are revalidated; a matching implanted stolen Feruchemical source can authorize its donor key as an explicit interpretation.
implementation: MetalmindLedger, SpikeLedger and FeruchemicalEngine. New recipient-filled minds key to the recipient; removing/draining the matching spike removes donor-key authorization.

statement: New characters begin without powers. Persistent spiritweb/contact/implant equipment survives death as a game policy; active effects do not persist. Hemalurgy can transfer a real donor source; natural power acquisition and broader death balance remain future work.
implementation: Persistent Fabric attachments and transient runtime modes; powered-NPC setup is explicitly administrative.

statement: God metals, a complete canonical anatomy map, advanced constructs and Compounding remain deferred. Fortune, Connection and unsealed access have bounded game interpretations; their exact canonical metaphysics and medallion construction are not asserted.
implementation: ADVANCED_ARTS.md records actual handlers and limits. No Excisor simulation or arbitrary causality/language translation is claimed.

statement: The author describes larger metal sources as stronger Push/Pull anchors and small flakes as poor anchors.
implementation: MetalPhysics weakens small grounded item anchors. Exact mass scales and force values are gameplay policies.

statement: Ordinary fuel excludes the invested subset. Integer prepaid costs, a fourfold flare cost, a 1.8 flare strength multiplier, effect caps and transient active modes are implementation policies.
implementation: ReserveLedger, BurnBudget, BurnEngine and AllomancyRuntime. Invested fuel is reserved until Compounding is designed.

statement: The initial Minecraft adaptation uses reciprocal line forces for Steel/Iron, temporary physical attribute modifiers for Pewter, and dark vision plus environmental hearing for Tin. Numeric fatigue, overload, collision damage and complete ordinary-force resistance for invested items are gameplay policies.
implementation: First four Allomantic powers with up to eight selected targets, shared force and combined recoil. Grid/wheel switching and bounded five-sense cues exist. Particle lines, advanced Investiture resistance and savantism remain limited or future work.

statement: Physical Feruchemy uses individual contacted assets, integer charge, up to 75% storing, aggregate tapping up to 400% and superlinear high-rate costs. Numerical effects, capacity, death-retained equipment and carrying profiles are game adaptations.
implementation: Canonical world ledger, transfer revisions, Identity checks, separate Tin senses and source-independent modifier IDs. Identity-free filling, unsealed access and Compounding are not implemented.

statement: The eight alloy ratios are documented gameplay interpretations. Exact and off-ratio batches are distinguished; these numbers are not claimed to be verified universal canon.
implementation: Data-driven alloy recipes with composition and viable/imperfect/invalid outcomes.

statement: One ingot equals nine nuggets, nine hundred measured portions, or nine grams of credited metal. Ore recovery yields and silicon/carbon processing are game abstractions, not real smelting chemistry.
implementation: Integer mass bookkeeping and recipe-conservation tests. Zinc refining credits eight zinc nuggets plus one cadmium nugget.

statement: Non-Allomantic and off-ratio metals are refused by the brewing/drinking path rather than inventing canonical injury values. Drinking transfers fuel without granting access or activating a power.
implementation: Server-side vial validation. Invested slicing and ingestion preserve residual mass, charge and Identity.

statement: Extraction retains 90 percent potency; logarithmic outside decay approaches a nonzero floor, blood slows exposure twentyfold and implantation stops exposure. Rates, curve and world-time accounting are gameplay policies.
implementation: Canonical spike assets preserve original potency, exposure and source tombstones; tooltips are previews. Rejected damage rolls back provisional ownership and held-item escrow.

statement: Twelve stable anatomical points, material compatibility and an explicit dangerous upper-back linchpin hook are game interpretations. The source establishes placement-dependent transfer, not these exact points or a complete construct anatomy.
implementation: BindingPoints evidence catalog and M-H inventory; default-off player extraction additionally requires consent and PvP permission. Implant/contact equipment retention on death is a game policy.

statement: Native cognition supports analysis; Connection/Identity adds bounded rapport and donor-key authorization; Fortune changes Luck and opportunity cues; Investiture scales existing access. These bounded handlers do not complete destiny, constructs or arbitrary abilities.
implementation: HemalurgyRuntime, EffectivePower and AdvancedFeruchemy; full constructs and exceptional nonlethal extraction remain deferred.

statement: Persistent emotion intensity, awareness and recovery affect eligible AI/player attributes. Aimed influence is resisted by Copper, determination, Identity and fortitude; no unrestricted mind control.
implementation: Combined frame deltas, entity tags, PvP/Creative protection.

statement: Aluminum/Chromium consume internal fuel including invested subsets without deleting ownership. Duralumin/Nicrosil exhaust concurrently paid eligible metals for one bounded amplified frame.
implementation: Snapshot/resolve, power cap32, boost cap8; physical safety limits retained.

statement: Anchored bubbles affect non-player clocks and supported processing machines. Players receive movement/action multipliers. Vehicles, general scheduled/random/redstone ticks and player physiology retain global time.
implementation: TemporalEngine overlaps clamp0.25..4; collapse on owner exit; five-degree projectile boundary deflection is a game interpretation.

statement: Gold interprets real recorded routes; Electrum projects bounded movement/projectile possibilities. Neither invents biography nor promises arbitrary futures.
implementation: Owner-only branches, uncertainty cues, paid collision-checked opening.

statement: Actual body resources precede storage credit; canonical tapping charge precedes benefit. Numeric temperature, fatigue, food/air escrow and healing rates are game adaptations.
implementation: Body resets on death; journal/Connection and charged equipment persist; no offline body accrual.

statement: Copper moves access to specific observed mod records. Stored entries leave mod journal/history; tapping restores once. Player knowledge, vanilla advancements and arbitrary mod data are outside this model.
implementation: World-indexed unique memory IDs, contact/Identity checks, private paginated UI.

statement: Nicrosil stores a specific owned A/F ability type. Paid storage suppresses access; tapping grants temporary sourced access. Types cannot be exchanged as generic energy.
implementation: Art/metal/strength payload, per-type caps, physical source checks, no persistent grant.

statement: Full paid Identity suppression fills empty pools unkeyed. Deliberate unsealing consumes an ordinary Duralumin ring while tapping Connection and storing full Identity. This is an intuitive crafting adaptation, not a verified Excisor recipe.
implementation: Free charged unkeyed typed nicrosilmind; ordinary recipients spend charge for one temporary type; other minds still require ability/contact/key.

statement: Connection affects supported villager rapport and actual regional familiarity. Fortune modifies vanilla Luck and bounded loaded-world opportunities. No arbitrary factions, universal translation or causality.
implementation: Reversible merchant price deltas preserve reputation; tagged probes never generate chunks.

statement: RashekKholin and The17thShard receive baseline access to all standard Allomantic and Feruchemical metals through verified account UUIDs when enableAccountPowers is true. This public configurable perk is not a canonical acquisition rule or operator privilege.
implementation: AccountPowers and EffectivePower apply a nonpersistent access overlay. Normal fuel/contact/charge/Identity costs, Nicrosil suppression and protections remain. Disabling removes only this overlay; raw grants are untouched. No username fallback, hidden dependency or tamper penalty.

statement: A compatible charged physical source is consumed once into a compatible contacted destination at the configured multiplier. Copper restores existing memories once without duplicating facts.
implementation: MetalmindLedger spent tombstones and Compounding preflight preserve source, type and Identity.

statement: Prepared canonical spikes and paired innate Blessings enable bounded Koloss, Inquisitor and Kandra body templates; preparation costs and template slots are gameplay adaptations.
implementation: ConstructLedger and ConstructRuntime; author discussion: https://www.brandonsanderson.com/blogs/blog/annotation-mistborn-3-chapter-thirty-nine

statement: Once-only latent allocation, injury awakening, XP discovery, powered hostile population and the optional mistwraith ritual are survival adaptations, not verified cosmere genetics or a canonical human-to-mistwraith recipe.
implementation: ProgressionState persists independently of grants so extraction/death cannot reroll powers.

statement: Two or three unsealed typed ability cores retain independent charge and leases. The assembly command is a gameplay substitute for the incompletely published Excisor process.
implementation: Medallions carrier unfolds into actual contact slots; no universal unlimited-power item.

statement: Pure Lerasium grants standard Allomancy; alloys grant the associated standard-metal Allomancy. Strength 2, crouch-use, bounded non-stacking and the optional boss/material acquisition recipe are gameplay choices.
implementation: LerasiumItem; author interview index https://wob.coppermind.net/adv_search/?tags=lerasium and https://wob.coppermind.net/events/9-calamity-philadelphia-signing/#e7624. Direct event retrieval was blocked during this audit; do not treat exact quantities as canon.

statement: Pure Atium, Era-one Atium/electrum, Malatium, Harmonium, Trellium and other shard metals/alloys need separate evidenced designs. No invented unknown effect is enabled.
implementation: Stable sixteen-metal contracts are unchanged; Lerasium is separate.
